_comment: Shared session phrases; independent of legacy prompts and per-step build references.
greeting: Hi, I'm Nao. I'm going to describe a Mega Bloks build to you one step at a time. Hold my right foot bumper while you talk to me, and let go when you're done. When you want me to check your build, press my left foot bumper.
look: Okay, let me take a look.
goodbye: That matches. Nice work, we're all done.
early_goodbye: Aw, it looks like we're out of time! Thank you for building with me. I had a lot of fun!
